summary.text: Blaine Sefton is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Tyler Johnson (R).
An electrician and a member of IBEW Local 305, he listed union power, housing and higher taxes on high earners among his key messages in a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Blaine Sefton earned a high school diploma from Liberty-Benton High School, and his career experience includes working as an electrician, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Sefton said he belongs to the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, Local 305, and has lived in Ohio, Indiana and Michigan, settling in Indiana as an adult.

His three key messages were union power, including protecting workers' rights to strike and form a union; housing, including rent-controlled units and a right to counsel for tenants; and raising taxes on the highest earners and corporations.
He also said he supports a Green New Deal and public ownership of major transit and the energy grid.
